method.fixture: Same controlled five-customer scene as performance-components; 18 s cold preparation and 12 s warm measurement.
method.display: Canvas is fully visible; DPR 2 at 2200 x 1600 and DPR 3 at 2970 x 2160. Both profiles compared at 100% render scale.
method.fps: Draw opportunities per elapsed second, not physical scanout or unique authored poses.
method.coldLongGaps: Sum of entire rAF gaps exceeding 50 ms, not excess over a frame deadline.
method.memory: Managed graphics surfaces, not physical VRAM or complete process memory.
method.pixelComparison: Classic and restored Classic at authored sample times versus prior cache policy; five screens at three backing widths. Optimized intentionally changes appearance. Fractional decorative interpolation is disabled in Classic.
method.ui: Visible isolated browser, actual controls on source/site/standalone. Offline blocked-storage check. Emulated touch on Intel. No physical touchscreen claim.
method.scenarios: Production core/renderer complete tutorial, cooking, payment, full day, next day and three retry cycles, accelerated deterministic simulation; not a realtime day performance benchmark.
